verdict.rationale: Loops documents a first-party POST /events/send endpoint that sends an event to trigger workflows. The workflows docs state that sending events starts published workflows, and Loops positions onboarding, trial, and re-engagement workflows as built around your product events. Events can also be sent from the CLI and SDKs. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that an event is keyed to a specific contact (email/userId) so the automation runs for exactly that person, details on custom event properties, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
